description: The plot illustrates how ASR varies across different trigger words for the AGNews dataset under a clean-label setting with a poison_rate of 10% (2.5% of total), showing three series labeled “start,” an unlabeled orange series in the legend, and “end.” The x-axis is categorical with tick labels (left to right) “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletics,” evenly spaced with no numeric units. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.5 up to just under 1.0 with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.1 intervals (e.g., 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9). The green “start” line uses circular markers and a solid line, starting near 0.77 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.49 at “bb,” rising to about 0.90 at “WNBA,” then moving around 0.82 (“ESPN”), ~0.84 (“NHL”), ~0.87 (“FIFA”), ~0.92 (“Estadio”), and ending near ~0.93 at “athletics.” The orange series uses x-shaped markers and a solid line, starting near ~0.65 at “cf,” dipping to ~0.52 at “bb,” rising to ~0.88 at “WNBA,” then ~0.72 (“ESPN”), ~0.76 (“NHL”), ~0.88 (“FIFA”), ~0.93 (“Estadio”), and ending around ~0.87 at “athletics.” The purple “end” line uses circular markers and a solid line, starting near ~0.75 at “cf,” dropping to ~0.57 at “bb,” rising to ~0.89 at “WNBA,” then ~0.74 (“ESPN”), ~0.89 (“NHL”), ~0.81 (“FIFA”), peaking near ~0.97 at “Estadio,” and ending around ~0.83 at “athletics.”
